explanation: At GO it is always about 0; at D1 it is 10 if the previous trial was rewarded, and 7-9 if not (dropping to 3-5 after two or more unrewarded trials in a row or very early in the episode). At D2 it tracks the choice: after a1 it is low (0-2 when S1 is reached, 2-6 after a rare S2), and after a2 it is mid-high (S2 common 5-9, rare S1 about 2 lower), growing over the episode so that a2 trials before trial 35 sit at only 2-4.
